subject: Request: Post-audit affirmation for SOC 2 (bridge letter) - SolarGrid
messages:
From: Claire Dubois <claire.dubois@solargrid.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: bridge letter to cover SOC 2 gap

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency numbers and the routing options. Procurement is running the security check now and asked whether Redwood can provide a bridge letter (or attestation) to cover the period since the SOC 2 Type II report ended (2024-12-31) through today.

Specifically they want:
- A bridge letter from Redwood or from your auditor confirming there have been no material changes to controls since 2024-12-31, or describing any material exceptions and compensating controls.
- The SOC 2 Type II report PDF and the auditor name/firm.
- Preferably a dated letter they can include in their compliance package; if there is a standard template your auditor uses, that works too.

Can you confirm whether Hilltop Audit (your auditor) can issue this and an estimated turnaround? Procurement is on a tight cadence (they want to close internal review by 5/25).

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Claire
Claire Dubois
Senior Security Manager, SolarGrid Inc.
attachments: none

Subject: Re: Request: bridge letter to cover SOC 2 gap

Hi Claire — thanks for the note and the context.

Short answer: yes, we can provide the SOC 2 Type II report and work with our auditor to issue either a bridge letter or an interim attestation. A few details so we align:
- Our most recent SOC 2 Type II report covers the period 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31 (we've attached the PDF).
- Our external auditor is Hilltop Audit LLP (Amanda Li, CPA). They have historically issued bridge letters for customers where the procurement team needs coverage between the report end date and current date.
- For speed, procurement acceptance typically prefers a Hilltop-signed bridge letter. Hilltop can do a short letter stating (a) the report end date, (b) that Hilltop is not aware of material changes to the control environment since that date, or (c) list any exceptions.

Rafael / Grace — can you review the attached draft bridge letter (I pulled a template Hilltop provided last year and tailored it for SolarGrid) and confirm we’re OK to route this to Amanda for signature? Rafael — quick legal/wording check particularly around the "not aware" phrasing and scope.

Claire — I pasted the draft into the attached doc. If acceptable, I will send to Hilltop and request a signed DocuSign by EOD 5/20; Amanda typically takes 2–3 business days once she has the request and the draft.

Thanks,
Mina

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: bridge letter to cover SOC 2 gap

Mina / Grace,

I reviewed the draft. A couple small suggestions to reduce legal exposure:
- Replace any absolute wording like "no changes" with "no material changes to the control environment that would reasonably be expected to affect the security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, or privacy principles covered by the report."
- Add a single sentence clarifying the bridge letter is not a substitute for a full SOC 2 report and does not alter the scope of the underlying engagement.
- Keep the auditor's statement limited to observations (Hilltop will not—and should not—provide new attestation over a period they didn't audit).

With those edits the draft looks fine to route to Hilltop. I also recommend we ask Hilltop to sign and date the letter and include the auditor contact (Amanda Li) and the DocuSign link so SolarGrid has an auditable artifact.

Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Director, Legal Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Amanda Li <amanda.li@hilltopaudit.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Dubois <claire.dubois@solargrid.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: bridge letter to cover SOC 2 gap

Hello Mina / Rafael,

Thanks for sending the draft. Hilltop Audit can prepare a bridge letter; we typically:
- Confirm the report period (2024-01-01 through 2024-12-31)
- State the date the bridge letter is issued (e.g., 2026-05-19)
- Indicate we are not aware of any material changes to controls since the report period end that would affect the scope areas tested.

We will not issue a new attestation over the intervening period but can provide the letter you described. We made the small wording tweaks Rafael suggested and attached our final PDF. Please review and confirm; once you approve we will route through DocuSign.

Estimated time: once approved, we can have a signed DocuSign in 1–2 business days.

Best,
Amanda Li, CPA
